deterministic: no timestamps, no line numbers, stable key order; two consecutive runs are byte-identical

method.scan: static scan of the four surfaces (page markup, markup authored in JS template strings, stylesheets) plus tokens.json
method.tokenRefs: var(--x) in a page or stylesheet; plus quoted custom-property reads inside CT(…), WA(…) and getPropertyValue(…) calls — those are counted in `dynamic`
method.componentInstances: ds-* names in class="…" attributes (including escaped markup inside JS template strings, flagged dynamic), classList.add/remove/toggle/contains, className =, setAttribute('class', …)
method.quarantine: a docsOnly surface and any stylesheet only it loads are counted but never contribute to productRefCount
method.attribution: a shared stylesheet ref counts once per surface that links the sheet, so productRefCount is reach and may exceed refCount
method.aliasEdges: aliasOf is the token this value points at; aliasedBy lists tokens that point at this one
method.counts: bySurface is reach (page refs plus stylesheet refs attributed to every surface that links the sheet); direct is page-source refs only; cssFiles is stylesheet refs per file; productRefCount sums bySurface over non-docsOnly surfaces
method.blockOwnership: a component belongs to the first numbered section of components.css in which it is the subject of a selector, not a member of a shared :is(…) group
blindSpots: Authored occurrences, not DOM nodes: one template that renders N rows counts once.
Class names built by concatenation (`'ds-' + kind`) are not resolvable statically.
Runtime style.setProperty('--x', …) writes are invisible; the scan reads literals only.
A var() inside a @media width query is invalid CSS and cannot appear; breakpoints are criteria, not consumers.
CSS refs are attributed to every surface loading the stylesheet, including refs that only matter under @media print.
